item.title: You will be disabled one day
item.description: Last semester, I heard a fellow student complaining about law school, and in particular, people who get extended time on the bar exam, and who said something along the lines of "some people aren't meant to be lawyers." item.title: The Winter Olympics opening ceremony: A fusion of artistry and athleticism
item.description: While the snowy South Bend weather continues piling up and the scarves are nowhere near being put away, we all need a winter romanticization.
